name: CIB seven - Ad Hoc Sub Process
description: Without an AI agent: starts chosen activities on entry and collects a result from each completed activity.

properties.label: Activities to start on entry
properties.description: Comma-separated activity ids, e.g. callCustomer,checkLogs. Only activities with no incoming sequence flow. Also a JSON array or ${expression}. Empty: none.

pattern.message: Enter activity ids separated by commas, a JSON array or an expression.

properties.label: Collect results in variable
properties.description: Name of the list variable, e.g. findings: one value per completed activity. Needs 'Result per activity'.

properties.label: Result per activity
properties.description: Evaluated when an activity completes; the value is added to the list, null is skipped. Example: ${execution.hasVariable('finding') ? finding : null}
